001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.MatchType;
004import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
005
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.UUID;
008
009public interface Match extends Spectatable {
010
011    /**
012     * Get the players of the match.
013     * @return The players of the match
014     */
015    List<Player> getPlayers();
016
017    /**
018     * Get the spectators of the match.
019     * @return The spectators of the match
020     */
021    List<Player> getSpectators();
022
023    /**
024     * Get the amount of wins needed to win the match.
025     * @return The amount of wins needed to win the match
026     */
027    int getWinsNeeded();
028
029    /**
030     * Get the ladder name of the match.
031     * @return The ladder name of the match, or null if not set
032     */
033    String getLadderName();
034
035    /**
036     * Get the ladder display name of the match.
037     * @return The ladder display name of the match, or null if not set
038     */
039    String getLadderDisplayName();
040
041    /**
042     * Get the unique id of the match.
043     * @return The match id, never null
044     * @since 2.4.0
045     */
046    default String getMatchId() {
047        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
048    }
049
050    /**
051     * Get the name of the arena the match is played in.
052     * @return The arena name, never null
053     * @since 2.4.0
054     */
055    default String getArenaName() {
056        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * Check whether the match is ranked.
061     * @return true if the match is ranked
062     * @since 2.4.0
063     */
064    default boolean isRanked() {
065        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
066    }
067
068    /**
069     * Get the type of the match.
070     * @return The match type, never null; {@link MatchType#UNKNOWN} for types added by a newer core version
071     * @since 2.4.0
072     */
073    default MatchType getMatchType() {
074        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
075    }
076
077    /**
078     * Get how long the match has been running.
079     * @return The duration in seconds
080     * @since 2.4.0
081     */
082    default int getDurationSeconds() {
083        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
084    }
085
086    /**
087     * Get the current round number.
088     * @return The current round number, 1-based
089     * @since 2.4.0
090     */
091    default int getCurrentRoundNumber() {
092        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * Get the inventory snapshots of every player in every finished round. Main thread only.
097     * Snapshots of a round are available from MatchRoundEndEvent of that round, and all of them from MatchEndEvent.
098     * @return An unmodifiable list sorted by round number, never null. Players offline at round end are missing.
099     * @since 2.6.0
100     */
101    default List<RoundInventory> getRoundInventories() {
102        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.6.0+");
103    }
104
105    /**
106     * Get the inventory snapshots of one player in every finished round. Main thread only.
107     * @param player The player's unique id
108     * @return An unmodifiable list sorted by round number, never null
109     * @since 2.6.0
110     */
111    default List<RoundInventory> getRoundInventories(UUID player) {
112        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.6.0+");
113    }
114
115    /**
116     * Get the inventory snapshot of one player in one round. Main thread only.
117     * @param player The player's unique id
118     * @param round The round number, 1-based
119     * @return The snapshot, or null if none was saved for that player and round
120     * @since 2.6.0
121     */
122    default RoundInventory getRoundInventory(UUID player, int round) {
123        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.6.0+");
124    }
125
126}
